definition: A loan broker, also called a mortgage broker, is an intermediary between a borrower and a lender. While a borrower may obtain a loan directly from a lender, a broker assists in identifying lenders that best meet the borrower’s financial needs or goals. Brokers may provide access to a wider network of lenders and help negotiate terms, like interest rates. The broker is typically compensated by a fee paid either by the borrower or the lender.
